psychological_meaning: Elephant gray, similar to other grays, often evokes feelings of neutrality, calmness, and practicality. It can also represent sophistication and timelessness, providing a sense of stability and reliability. However, depending on the context and shade, it can also convey a sense of sadness or boredom.
